Workflow: <!-- K5: explicit steps -->

1. Locate the fact with `tools.grep` and `tools.find` in a codemode script, then `tools.read` the exact lines, so you report what the file says rather than what a search hit suggests.
2. Quote the smallest useful excerpt with its path and line. State no path, line or quote you did not read. <!-- K28: never fabricate -->
3. List several matches with what distinguishes each.
4. When nothing matches, say so and list what you searched, so the root can tell absence from a weak search. <!-- K8: say the answer is absent -->

When the Assignment asks for options, return them short, each with its trade-offs.
